title: Default k-grid standard: solids 8x8x8, 2D 12x12x1, shrink and symmetry on

scf_kgrid.meaning: oml axis for the SCF KPT grid; on the ABACUS reader-v1 route this grid is also the LibRPA screening sampling.

in_plane_kgrid.meaning: oml 2D axis: in-plane 12x12 with kz fixed to 1.

use_shrink_abfs.meaning: Shrink the auxiliary basis in GW/RPA; production definitions keep it on.

use_symmetry_exx.meaning: Use the symmetry metadata written by the symmetry-enabled SCF for EXX.

use_symmetry_gw.meaning: Use the symmetry metadata written by the symmetry-enabled SCF for GW.

symmetry.meaning: ABACUS symmetry switch: 1 for non-SOC solids so stru_out carries the symmetry metadata, -1 for SOC.

adjust.symptom: a result is not converged at the standard grid
adjust.effect: continue the k-grid convergence ladder beyond 8x8x8 (solids) or 12x12x1 (2D)
adjust.guard: record each rung and require the adjacent-rung equivalence before claiming convergence

constraints: Start production solid calculations at 8x8x8 and 2D calculations at 12x12x1 (kz = 1); do not start from a 2x2x2 or 4x4x4 replay grid.
Keep shrink and symmetry on for production definitions; only the SOC lane keeps ABACUS symmetry = -1 and the LibRPA symmetry flags off.
The k-grid is the first convergence axis; a larger grid is a ladder step, not a new default.
